test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following country's church, hotel and tourist place were attacked by suicide bombers during Easter celebrations in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sri Lanka**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

- "Sri Lanka" faced coordinated bombings on Easter Sunday, April 21, 2019. - The attacks targeted three "churches", four "hotels", and a "housing complex". - Over "250 people" were killed and more than "500 injured" in the bombings. - The attacks were carried out by "Islamist extremist" groups, including the local group "National Thowheeth Jama'ath (NTJ)". - The incident raised global concerns about "terrorism" and "security" in "South Asia".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 "Easter Sunday"
 A significant "Christian holiday" celebrating the resurrection of "Jesus Christ" from the dead.
 
 

 "National Thowheeth Jama'ath (NTJ)"
 A "radical Islamist" group in Sri Lanka that was involved in the 2019 Easter bombings.
 
 

 "Impact"
 The attacks led to a "state of emergency" and heightened "security measures" across Sri Lanka.
 
 

 "Global Response"
 The international community condemned the attacks and offered "support" to Sri Lanka.
 
 

 "Tourism"
 The bombings had a significant negative impact on Sri Lanka's "tourism industry", a major part of its economy.
